html:
The Gkuthaarn, or Kuthant, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the country around today's Normanton, on the Norman River near the Gulf of Carpentaria in Queensland. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Their language, Gkuthaarn, is an extinct Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family, and records of it are thin. Neighbours on the map include the Kukatj, the Kurtjar and the Walangama. Normanton was founded in 1868 as a port for the Gulf cattle country, and later served the Croydon gold field. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
